juno: FYI ran a staging sweep on the Rust SDK with prefetch=2 + shared quota and saw a "quota tilt" where one connection's retries ate the bucket and others got hard-429'd. Repro steps below.

rahul: Steps?

juno: 1) start 4 clients using same API key 2) each client prefetch=2 page_size=20 3) inject intermittent 5xx on page N to force retries 4) observe tenant-level token bucket drain and duplicate fetches.

ziya: Logs: ```
WARN quota: global_balance=120 tenant_balance=16 tenant=B delta=-40
INFO prefetch: spawned=8 active=6 cursor_mismatch=2
ERROR retry: duplicate_fetch page=42 cursor=tok_a1 (retry-dup)
```

ops-lucy: Is this specific to Rust? We had parity protections in JS that checked cursor identity before reserving credit.

juno: Yes, Rust reserves prefetch credit immediately on spawn and then validates cursor; that order lets retries re-reserve before release. JS defers reserve until after validation.

rahul: Quick mitigation: 1) change Rust to defer reserve until inside prefetch worker after cursor validation, 2) add a CAS reserve API `reserveIfCurrent(cursor_id, amount)` to avoid double-reserve on retries.

ziya: Also add a short TTL for reservations so long-held prefetch reservations don't block others. 500ms default seemed to work in staging.

ops-lucy: Telemetry: emit `prefetch_reserve_failures`, `duplicate_page_fetches`, and `reservation_hold_ms`. Add an alert if duplicate_page_fetches > 0.5% of requests for 5m.

juno: I pushed a tiny patch prototype: move reserve after `if cursorStillCurrent()` and use `bucket.reserveIf(cursor.id, cost)`. Local bench reduced duplicate fetches by ~90%.

rahul: Can you open a PR with the change + unit test that simulates cursor rotation + injected 5xx? Also update sampleapp config to default `prefetch=1` for Rust until parity lands.

juno: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-rust/pull/421 (WIP) - includes test and a short doc note.

devex-bot: Issue created: #5677-rust-prefetch-reserve-parity (assigned to rahul) https://issues.redwood.ai/5677

rahul: I'll review and add the CAS reserve API. For canary, deploy with `reservation_ttl_ms=500` and `prefetch=1` for 1h, abort if `duplicate_page_fetches` > 1% or `tenant_balance` drops below -30.

ziya: Also add an integration that runs 4 concurrent clients in staging to assert no tenant gets >2x credit drift versus median.

juno: I'll add the integration harness and attach logs. Thanks all.

ops-lucy: Quick doc blurb for devex: "Workaround: set sample.prefetch=1 and reservation_ttl_ms=500 for high-churn feeds until SDKs have parity guard."

juno: Will include that in PR. :thumbsup:
